usamo-usamo-1992-01.prompt:
Find, as a function of $n$, the sum of the digits of
$$9 \times 99 \times 9999 \times \cdots \times \left( 10^{2^n} - 1 \right),$$
where each factor has twice as many digits as the previous one.

usamo-usamo-1992-02.answer: $\dfrac{\sin 1^\circ}{\cos k^\circ\cos(k+1)^\circ} = \tan(k+1)^\circ - \tan k^\circ$, so the sum times $\sin 1^\circ$ telescopes to $\tan 89^\circ = \cot 1^\circ$.

usamo-usamo-1992-03.prompt: For a nonempty set $S$ of integers, let $\sigma(S)$ be the sum of the elements of $S$. Suppose that $A = \{a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{11}\}$ is a set of positive integers with $a_1 < a_2 < \cdots < a_{11}$ and that, for each positive integer $n \le 1500$, there is a subset $S$ of $A$ for which $\sigma(S) = n$. What is the smallest possible value of $a_{10}$?

usamo-usamo-1992-04.prompt: Chords $AA'$, $BB'$, and $CC'$ of a sphere meet at an interior point $P$ but are not contained in the same plane. The sphere through $A$, $B$, $C$, and $P$ is tangent to the sphere through $A'$, $B'$, $C'$, and $P$. Prove that $AA'=BB'=CC'$.
usamo-usamo-1992-04.answer: The two small spheres are tangent at $P$, so a homothety centred at $P$ maps one to the other and sends $A, B, C$ to $A', B', C'$: $PA' = \lambda PA$ etc. With the power of $P$ in the big sphere, $\lambda PA^2 = \lambda PB^2 = \lambda PC^2$, so $PA = PB = PC$ and $PA' = PB' = PC'$.

usamo-usamo-1992-05.prompt: Let $P(z)$ be a polynomial with complex coefficients which is of degree $1992$ and has distinct zeros. Prove that there exist complex numbers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{1992}$ such that $P(z)$ divides the polynomial $\left( \cdots \left( (z-a_1)^2 - a_2 \right)^2 \cdots - a_{1991} \right)^2 - a_{1992}$.
usamo-usamo-1992-05.answer: Induction on the number of prescribed roots: if $Q$ vanishes at $z_1, \ldots, z_k$, then adjusting the last two constants turns $Q$ into $Q(z)\,(Q(z) - Q(z_{k+1}))$, which also vanishes at $z_{k+1}$.
